basic_info.description: This is it, YOUR NEW HOME! Welcome to this beautifully updated home with amazing views in the highly desirable Noe Valley neighborhood of lovely San Francisco. Boasting numerous high-end upgrades and immaculate attention to detail throughout, this stunning property features a bright and open floor plan, designer paint, gorgeous wood flooring, modern bathrooms (with heated floor in master bath), LED lights with dimmers in all rooms, tankless water heater, Nest thermostat, and a truly exquisite kitchen with quartz countertops, stylish cabinets, and top-of-the-line appliances (Kitchenaid refrigerator, Thermador stove top with infrared food warmers, Bosch quiet dishwasher). Outside, enjoy the exquisite patio and backyard area, with incredible views of the city, on top of finished decks and luscious greens, perfect for relaxation or entertaining guests. The house can also be expanded below the upper deck area if your preference is a bigger home. Whatever your lifestyle, Noe Valley's ideal location and distinctive community lets you create a life uniquely you, and this beautiful modern home will have you and your family living the good life for years to come. WELCOME TO YOUR NEW HOME!
